operational_definition: Explicit adversary, attack success measure, security threat, or defense.
Evaluates a failure mode such as semantic misalignment, instability, noisy concepts, or non-identifiability that can undermine an audit without a malicious actor.
Proves a property about an explanation or model under explicit assumptions.
Post-hoc XAI/privacy result used to establish a mechanism or transfer question; not direct proof about intrinsic carriers.
Survey, SoK, or evaluation resource used for search seeding, comparison, or metric context.
Final prediction resists malicious or selective change under the stated threat model.
Explanatory state cannot be arbitrarily changed while prediction is preserved or made plausible while prediction changes.
Displayed carrier corresponds to the human meaning it claims to represent.
Edits to writable carrier state have bounded, intended, authorized effects.
Evidence is stable/reproducible/certifiable enough for repeatable auditing.
Exposing carrier state does not cause unacceptable model/training/private information leakage.
Assign ONLY after a named original study explicitly measures/tests the given ICS property. Record source page, setup, and outcome.
Assign ONLY after original-source inspection confirms a finding that informs but does not directly test the ICS property.
Absence of a code in the manuscript is not evidence of absence in the original paper; unknown remains unless explicitly supported by a source passage.

The submitting author reports reviewing all cited sources. That author statement differs from automated CSV/PDF title agreement, independent publisher metadata checks, and per-claim source-page citations; see the separate fields and review statement.
Appendix D Table XII columns Input, Poison/Backdoor, Semantic, Intervene, Privacy, Verify are evidence loci, not a one-to-one mapping to P1-P6 ICS contract properties.
